voice-scholarly-default.notes: False positive: the flagged informal phrasing is a direct Feynman quotation ('that you should not try to set up'), properly attributed with \cite{feynman1965} — quoted source text, not the paper's own voice.

trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of prose sec:bach-intro-prose (Feynman quote, Bach et al. novelty claim, Jonsson/Tonomura priority paragraph). Judged all ten categories in context.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: Cat.1: 'using biprisms rather than true double-slits' is substantive mathematical/experimental contrast - the distinction IS the priority claim - pass per the false-positive class. Cat.2: 'is true only in the sense that ...' is a concessive that delimits exactly what prior work achieved, not a setup-then-reframe pivot. Cat.9: 'the first to combine both elements' is a factual priority claim carried from the source paper, not manufactured superlative. NOTE (not a trap): Jonsson (1961) and Tonomura (1989) are attributed by year with no \\cite key; only bach2013 and feynman1965 are cited.
